head: 7c08ea890746b1914c2f6e825523482a9146114c
boundary: Local read-only Git/worktree/index/source-hash audit paired to root latest recorded read-only database refresh. No new database query, writes, installation, native executable/authentication/load/visual acceptance or owner signoff.

database_refresh.query: select jsonb_build_object('observed_at',clock_timestamp(),'project_id','xpdoufauvrbdmxgngetv','migrations',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('version',version,'name',name) order by version) from supabase_migrations.schema_migrations),'api_catalogue',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',p.proname,'signature',pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid),'returns',pg_get_function_result(p.oid),'source_md5',md5(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid)),'acl',p.proacl::text) order by p.proname,pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid)) from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname='api'),'shared_helpers',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',p.proname,'signature',pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid),'source_md5',md5(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid))) order by p.proname) from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname='finance' and p.proname in ('flow_residual','wave3_lock_open_period','flow_post_journal','flow_allocate'))) as evidence;

shared_helpers.name: flow_allocate
shared_helpers.signature: p_source uuid, p_target uuid, p_tenant uuid, p_entity uuid, p_branch uuid, p_payload jsonb, p_date date, p_request uuid, p_command uuid

shared_helpers.name: flow_post_journal
shared_helpers.signature: p_doc jsonb, p_lines jsonb, p_source_type text, p_source_id uuid, p_request uuid, p_command uuid

shared_helpers.name: flow_residual
shared_helpers.signature: p_tenant uuid, p_id uuid, p_as_of date

shared_helpers.name: wave3_lock_open_period
shared_helpers.signature: p_tenant_id uuid, p_legal_entity_id uuid, p_posting_date date
